author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೋಪವನು ತಡೆದೊಡನೆ ತಾಪದಿಂ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯೊ
ಸೋಪಾನವಹುದದುವೆ ಧ್ಯೇಯ ಮಂದಿರಕೆ
ಜೋಪಾನದಿಂದಿರಲು ಭಾವಗಳು ಉಕ್ಕುತಿರೆ
ಕಾಪಿಡುವೆ ಶುದ್ಧಮನ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The moment you hold back anger, you are freed from its burning;
that itself is a stair to the temple of your goal;
and you will guard a pure mind, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Restraining anger frees us from its heat and moves us toward our goals. When feelings boil over, be careful, and the mind stays clear.
